title: DARebootAuto
description: A plugin who manages reboot. We can choose a few timer, a delay, a messages.
body:
# 🔄 DARebootAuto

**_DARebootAuto_** automatically saves and restarts your Paper/Spigot server at specific times of the day.
Stay in control with a fully configurable schedule, countdown messages, and simple admin commands.

## ✨ **Features**

⏰ Scheduled restarts at exact hours (24h format).

💾 Automatic save-all before every restart.

🕒 Configurable countdown with dynamic broadcast messages.

**🎛️ Simple admin commands:**

/dareboot reload → Reload configuration.

/dareboot now → Force an immediate restart.**

🎨 Customizable messages with placeholders ({delay} for seconds remaining).
